stackDivergence.rationale: Iteration84 implements original public ScMatrix constructors, genuine pImpl delegation, resize overloads, dimensions/count/coordinate validation and six inline UInt8 classifiers over actual ScMatrixImpl/shared mdds. The original64bit initial default536870912-element bound is preserved as a per-matrix bound; native live-pool debit/credit, environment override and refcount/unique_ptr destruction timing are deliberately omitted under the user GC-first instruction. Ordinary original definition excerpts over genuine dependencies compare25016-byte constructor/resize/coordinate observations and all256tags; allocation-boundary queries run before native objects exist and do not certify native live-pool equivalence. Invalid constructors/default resize use MatrixSize, filled resize uses StackOverflow; mdds resize may preserve existing cell data over the error initializer (CALC-072). No interpreter/Clone substitute, no duplicated storage. Typed access/mutations, Clone/interpreter/results/cell/document/input/UI, allocation exceptions/ABI and full upstream QA remain incomplete; broad parity flags stay false. Original QA anchors are unexecuted context. Next full91.
